description: Land Title Settlement Department - Senevigama, Rideemaliyadda D/S Division, Badulla District - Cad. Map No. 710027
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for multiple parcels in specific locations. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcels, their extents, ownership status (all owned by "The State"), and nature of the land (waterways, access roads, etc.). This falls squarely under Land Gazettes as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
